sn46.12:1.1: suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ aruṇuggaṃ
sn46.12:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā.
sn46.12:1.3: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissatīti.
sn46.12:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti.
sn46.12:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ. pe.
sn46.12:2.3: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.12:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarotīti.
